z-m-06-05.title: Kana ukanamatidza zvimedu zvetriangle zviviri, ndi hexagon here?
z-m-06-05.topic: Triangles nema quadrilaterals: huwandu hwemativi echimiro chakagadzirwa nekunamatidza zvimedu
z-m-06-05.goal: Ziva kuti huwandu hwemativi echimiro chakagadzirwa nekunamatidza zvimedu zvetriangle zviviri hunogona kusiyana zvichienderana nekunamatidza, uye utsvage uye ugadzirise chikamu chakashata mukufunga kwaSora.
z-m-06-05.material: Pane zvimedu zvepepa 2 zvakaita se right triangles. Zviviri izvi zvine saizi nechimiro zvakafanana chaizvo. Mativi maviri padivi pe right angle ndi3cm ne4cm, uye divi refu zvikuru ndi5cm. Right angle ikona ye square, uye kana ukabatanidza ma right angles maviri, anova mutsara mumwe wakatwasuka usina kukombama. Namatidza zviviri pamwe chete chaizvo padivi rimwe, pasina kufukidzana nepasina mukaha, kugadzira chimiro chimwe. Zvakanakazve kucheka pepa uye kuedza iwe pachako. Verenga kufunga kwaSora mutsara nemutsara.
z-m-06-05.thinking.0: Ongorora kuti chii chinoitika kumativi akanamatidzwa
z-m-06-05.prereq.0: Mativi nema right angles e triangles, quadrilaterals, ne hexagons (nhanho yeGrade 2)
z-m-06-05.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara mumwe mukufunga kwaSora usina kururama.
z-m-06-05.s.s1.hint.0: Paradzanisa kana mutsara mumwe nemumwe uri wekunamatidza zvisati zvanamatidzwa kana mushure mekunamatidza.
z-m-06-05.s.s1.hint.1: Fungidzira chimiro chakagadzirwa nekunamatidza zvimedu zvepepa zviviri padivi rimwe, uye uverenge mativi aunoona kunze rimwe rimwe.
z-m-06-05.s.s1.line.0: Chimedu che triangle chine mativi 3 rimwe nerimwe.
z-m-06-05.s.s1.line.1: Pane zviviri, saka pane mativi 3+3=6 ose.
z-m-06-05.s.s1.line.2: Kana ukanamatidza zviviri, mativi maviri akanamatidzwa haagoni kuonekwa kubva kunze.
z-m-06-05.s.s1.line.3: Saka chimiro chakagadzirwa nekunamatidza chine mativi 6.
z-m-06-05.s.s1.line.4: Chine mativi 6, saka chero zvaunonamatidza sei, chinova hexagon.
z-m-06-05.s.s1.explain: Mitsara 4 ne5 haina kururama. Mutsara 3 wakati mativi maviri akanamatidzwa haagoni kuonekwa kubva kunze, saka mativi anoonekwa kunze ndi6 kubvisa maviri iwayo. Asi mutsara 4 haina kuratidza izvozvo. 6 yemutsara 2 yakarurama sehuwandu hwemativi zvisati zvanamatidzwa. Kana wakasarudza mutsara wakatangira, siyanisa kana mitsara iyoyo iri yekunamatidza zvisati zvanamatidzwa kana mushure.

z-m-06-08.title: Ndakadhonza marble ka5 ndikawana tsvuku ka4. Chii chingava mubhegi?
z-m-06-08.topic: Mukana: kufungidzira zvirimo mubhegi kubva pamhedzisiro yakadhonzwa
z-m-06-08.goal: Kubva pamhedzisiro yakadhonzwa, taura zviitiko zvakati wandei zvinogona kuva mubhegi, uye usiyanise 'zviitiko zvinogona kuitika' ne 'zviitiko zvine mukana mukuru'.
z-m-06-08.material: Pane marble 8 ese mubhegi. Marble i tsvuku nebhuruu chete. Haugone kuona mukati, saka wakabvisa marble imwe, wakatarisa ruvara rwayo, wakaidzorera, wakasanganisa zvakanaka, uye wakaita izvi ka5. Mhedzisiro i tsvuku ka4 nebhuruu ka1. Yunha akati, "Inofanira kunge iine marble tsvuku dzakawanda mukati." uye Daon akati, "Inogona kunge iine marble 1 yebhuruu chete, handizvo here?"
z-m-06-08.prereq.0: Kupatsanura nhamba kusvika ku 8 kuita nhamba mbiri nekuenzanisa zvakawanda nezvishoma (padanho regiredhi re2)
z-m-06-08.s.s1.prompt: Kana mhedzisiro iyi yabuda, sarudza nzira dzese marble tsvuku nebhuruu dzinogona kuva nadzo mubhegi.
z-m-06-08.s.s1.hint.0: Pasarudzo imwe neimwe, tarisa rimwe nerimwe kana mhedzisiro iyi ichigona kubuda kana ukadhonza ka5 kubva mubhegi rakadaro.
z-m-06-08.s.s1.hint.1: Yeuka kuti marble inodzorerwa mushure mekubviswa, uye funga kana ruvara rune marble shoma rinogona kubudawo kakawanda.
z-m-06-08.s.s1.r.a: Wakasiya kuti tsvuku yakauya kamwe. Kana pasina marble tsvuku zvachose, haugone kuidhonza.
z-m-06-08.s.s1.r.b: Wakacherekedza kuti kunyange kana pane marble tsvuku 1 chete, inogona kuuya kakawanda kana ichidzorerwa uye ichidhonzwa zvakare.
z-m-06-08.s.s1.r.c: Wakasiya kuti bhuruu yakauya kamwe. Kana pasina marble bhuruu zvachose, haugone kuidhonza.
z-m-06-08.s.s1.r.d: Wakasarudza chiitiko apo ruvara rwese ruripo uye tsvuku i yakawanda.
z-m-06-08.s.s1.explain: Tsvuku nebhuruu zvose zvakauya, saka ruvara rwese runofanira kuva ne 1 kana kupfuura. Saka tsvuku 1 nebhuruu 7, netsvuku 5 nebhuruu 3, zvose zvinogoneka. Zvinongova kuti divi rine tsvuku dzakawanda rine mukana mukuru.
z-m-06-08.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira nzira 3 dzakasiyana bhegi raigona kuva nadzo apo mhedzisiro iyi inogona kubva. Nyora huwandu hwemarble tsvuku se r uye huwandu hwemarble bhuruu se b. Pane marble 8 ese.
z-m-06-08.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza kuti ruvara rwuviri rumwe nerumwe runofanira kuva nehuwandu hwakadini zvishoma mubhegi.
z-m-06-08.s.s2.hint.1: Chinja huwandu hwemarble tsvuku imwe panguva uye unyore mutebhura kuti huwandu hwemarble bhuruu hunova chii.
z-m-06-08.s.s2.ok.c1: Tsvuku nebhuruu zvose i 1 kana kupfuura.
z-m-06-08.s.s2.fail.c1: Tsvuku nebhuruu dzimwe nedzimwe dzakauya kamwe, saka ruvara rwese runofanira kuva 1 kana kupfuura.
z-m-06-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Tsvuku nebhuruu pamwe chete zvinofanira kuva 8.
z-m-06-08.s.s2.explain: Zviitiko zvese 7 zvinogoneka, kubva patsvuku 1 nebhuruu 7 kusvika patsvuku 7 nebhuruu 1. Divi rine tsvuku dzakawanda rine mukana mukuru, asi chinokosha i kuti hapana chiitiko chimwe chete chinogoneka.
z-m-06-08.s.s2.because.prompt: Enzanisa zvakataurwa naYunha nezvakataurwa naDaon uye unyore pfungwa dzako.
z-m-06-08.s.s2.because.hint.0: Patsanura zvakataurwa nevaviri kuita zvaunogona kutaura nechokwadi kubva pamhedzisiro yakadhonzwa nezvakafungidzirwa.
z-m-06-08.s.s2.because.hint.1: Funga zvakaparadzana kana chirevo chaYunha chinofanira kuva chakarurama uye kana chirevo chaDaon chinogona kuitika.
z-m-06-08.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora zvakaparadzana kuti vaviri vacho vari kutaura nezvechiitiko chipi here?
z-m-06-08.s.s2.because.model.0: Zvinoratidzika kuti pane marble tsvuku dzakawanda, asi hazvina chokwadi. Sezvakataura Daon, pangava ne marble 1 yebhuruu chete, uye kunyange kana pane marble tsvuku 1 chete, mhedzisiro yakadai inogona kuitika.
z-m-06-08.s.s2.because.model.1: 4 pa 5 yaiva tsvuku, saka zvakakodzera kufungidzira kuti pane marble tsvuku dzakawanda. Asi bhuruu yakauyawo, saka i chokwadi kuti pane marble bhuruu mukati.
z-m-06-08.s.s2.because.model.2: Zvinoitika kuti pane marble tsvuku dzakawanda, asi hatigone kuva nechokwadi. Mhedzisiro iyi inogona kubuda kunyange kana pane marble tsvuku 1 chete.

z-m-06-03.title: Hurongwa hwaSoyul hwemba yemablock hunofanira kugadziriswa papi?
z-m-06-03.topic: Unit cubes: nhamba panhurikidzwa yega yega nemutemo wekurongedza
z-m-06-03.goal: Uchishandisa mutemo wekuti mablock enhurikidzwa yepamusoro anofanira kutsigirwa nemablock enhurikidzwa yepazasi, wana chikamu chakaipa chehurongwa uye ugadzire hurongwa hwakawanda hunoteerera mutemo.
z-m-06-03.material: Unit cube bhokisi rakaita secube remapuranga rehukuru hwenzvimbo imwe. Soyul anoda kuvaka chimiro chemba achishandisa ma unit cubes ose 7. Mitemo ndeiyi. (1) Panhurikidzwa 1, isa ma unit cubes mumutsara mumwe pasina nzvimbo isina chinhu. (2) Ma unit cubes enhurikidzwa 2 anogona kuiswa chete pakarepo pamusoro pema unit cubes enhurikidzwa 1, uye block imwe chete yenhurikidzwa 2 inoenda pamusoro peblock imwe yenhurikidzwa 1. (3) Usavake nhurikidzwa 3. Verenga hurongwa hwaSoyul mutsara nemutsara.
z-m-06-03.prereq.0: Ruzivo rwekuvaka nhurikidzwa 1 nenhurikidzwa 2 nema unit cubes (ukuru hwegiredhi 2)
z-m-06-03.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara mumwe muhurongwa hwaSoyul usingateereri mitemo kana wakataurwa zvisirizvo.
z-m-06-03.s.s1.hint.0: Nongedza, rimwe nerimwe, kwakagara block yega yega yenhurikidzwa 2 pamablock enhurikidzwa 1.
z-m-06-03.s.s1.hint.1: Verenga kuti nzvimbo dzingani pamwe chete umo block yenhurikidzwa 2 inogona kuiswa pamablock 3 enhurikidzwa 1.
z-m-06-03.s.s1.line.4: Saka ndinogona kuvaka imba nehurongwa uhu.
z-m-06-03.s.s1.explain: Mitsara 3 ne5 hazvina kururama. Kana ukaisa 3 panhurikidzwa 1, pane nzvimbo 3 chete dzemablock enhurikidzwa 2, asi yakati isa 4. Kuverenga kwemutsara 4 (3+4=7) kwakarurama. Asi nhamba dzinowedzera kuita 7 hazviiti kuti ive hurongwa hunochengeta mitemo. Saka mhedziso yemutsara 5 haina kururama. Kana wakasarudza mutsara wekutanga, ongorora zvakare kana mitsara iyoyo ichienderana nemitemo.
z-m-06-03.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira hurongwa 2 hwakasiyana hunoshandisa ma unit cubes ose 7 uchichengeta mitemo yose. Nyora nhamba yakaiswa panhurikidzwa 1 se a uye nhamba iri panhurikidzwa 2 se b. Zvose nhurikidzwa 1 nenhurikidzwa 2 dzinofanira kuva nemablock.
z-m-06-03.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza nhamba yenhurikidzwa 1 uye uongorore kana mablock ose asara anogona kukwira pa nhurikidzwa 2.
z-m-06-03.s.s2.hint.1: Chinja nhamba yenhurikidzwa 1 uye uinyore padivi penhamba yenhurikidzwa 2, uye utarise zvinoitika kumitsara umo nhurikidzwa 2 ine mazhinji kupfuura nhurikidzwa 1.
z-m-06-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Zvose nhurikidzwa 1 nenhurikidzwa 2 dzine nhamba yechisikigo yemablock.
z-m-06-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Ita zvose nhurikidzwa 1 nenhurikidzwa 2 nhamba yechisikigo ye1 kana kupfuura.
z-m-06-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Mablock enhurikidzwa 1 nenhurikidzwa 2 pamwe chete anofanira kuva 7.
z-m-06-03.s.s2.ok.c3: Mablock ose enhurikidzwa 2 anogona kugara pamablock enhurikidzwa 1.
z-m-06-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Kana pane mablock enhurikidzwa 2 akawanda kupfuura enhurikidzwa 1, mamwe mablock haana chinoatsigira.
z-m-06-03.s.s2.explain: Hurongwa hunochengeta mitemo i4 panhurikidzwa 1 ne3 panhurikidzwa 2, 5 panhurikidzwa 1 ne2 panhurikidzwa 2, uye 6 panhurikidzwa 1 ne1 panhurikidzwa 2, hurongwa 3 pamwe chete. Hurongwa hune mazhinji panhurikidzwa 2, sa 3 panhurikidzwa 1 ne4 panhurikidzwa 2, hahugoni kuitwa nokuti mamwe mablock haana chinoatsigira.
z-m-06-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Nyora kuti nei plan yekutanga yaSoyul (3 pa floor 1, 4 pa floor 2) isingashande, uye utaure hukama pakati pehuwandu hwema blocks e floor 2 nehuwandu hwema blocks e floor 1.
z-m-06-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Ita mapeya uye unyore kuti block imwe neimwe ye4 ye floor 2 inogara pa block ipi ye floor 1.
z-m-06-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Rangarira kuti chii chinoitika kana block ye floor 2 isina mumwe wayo.
z-m-06-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakasanganisira poinzi yekuti 'panofanira kuva ne block imwe ye floor 1 pasi pe block imwe neimwe ye floor 2' here?
z-m-06-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakaenzanisa huwandu hwema blocks e floor 1 ne floor 2 here kana uchitsanangura?
z-m-06-03.s.s2.because.model.0: Ma blocks e floor 2 anogona kuiswa chete pamusoro pema blocks e floor 1, uye nema3 pa floor 1 pane nzvimbo 3 chete. Saka haugoni kuisa 4 pa floor 2. Huwandu hwema blocks e floor 2 haugoni kuva hwakawanda kupfuura hwema blocks e floor 1.
z-m-06-03.s.s2.because.model.1: Imwe ye4 haina block ye floor 1 pazasi kuitsigira, saka yaizoyangarara mumhepo. Saka huwandu hwema blocks e floor 2 hunofanira kuenzana kana kuva pasi pe floor 1.
z-m-06-03.s.s2.because.model.2: Layer ye1 ine matanda 3, saka unogona kuisa 3 chete pa layer ye2. Layer ye2 haifaniri kuva ne akawanda kupfuura layer ye1.

z-m-06-04.title: Zvakadini kana ukayera hallway imwe chete kaviri uye kureba kuchisiyana?
z-m-06-04.topic: Kureba: makosha anosiyana kana kureba kumwe chete kwayerwa kakawanda
z-m-06-04.goal: Kana kureba kumwe chete kwayerwa kakawanda uye makosha achisiyana zvishoma, ongorora nzira yekuyera uye usarudze nzira yekutaura kureba.
z-m-06-04.material: Tinoyera kureba kwe hallway yechikoro nenhonga ye1m. Tinoisa chiratidzo nechoko pamagumo enhonga, tinoisazve gumo renhonga kunzvimbo yakaratidzwa, uye tinoramba tichiyera. Tinoyera chikamu chasara nerula ye cm uye tinochinyora se '3m 40cm'. 1m ndi100cm. Hatisati taziva kureba chaiko kwe hallway.
z-m-06-04.thinking.0: Ongorora kuti nzira yekuyera inokanganisa sei mhedzisiro
z-m-06-04.thinking.1: Chinja kutonga kwako nguva imwe neimwe kukosha kutsva kuchisvika
z-m-06-04.thinking.2: Nyora uchisanganisira kuti unogona kuvimbwa kusvika kupi
z-m-06-04.prereq.0: Ziva kuti 1m ndi100cm uye verenga kureba kwakanyorwa ne m ne cm zvose (nhanho yeGrade 2)
z-m-06-04.s.s1.prompt: Nguva imwe neimwe mhedzisiro yekuyera painosvika, sarudza kutonga kwaunogona kuita zvino.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kana kukosha kutsva kwasvika, chinja zvose kuita unit imwe chete uye uenzanise kuti kunosiyana zvakadii nekukosha kwekare.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.hint.1: Kana makosha asiyana, tanga wabvunza kuti akayerwa sei, uye utarise kana makosha akayerwa nenzira imwe chete ari padhuze.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Boka A rakayera hallway kamwe chete ndokuwana 3m 40cm.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Zvaizova zvakanaka kutaura sei kureba kwe hallway?
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Kukosha kwakayerwa kamwe chete humboo hwakakosha, asi zvichiri nguva yakanyanya kutaura 'zvakadai chaizvo.' Kukurudzira kuyera zvakare kwakanaka, uye kuinyora se 'anenge' kwakanakawo.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakadaidza kukosha kwakayerwa kamwe chete kureba chaiko. Hausati watarisa kana kuyera zvakare kwaizopa kukosha kumwe chete.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Itore sezvakaita anenge 3m 40cm, uye uyere kamwe zvakare kutarisa.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakashandisa kukosha kwazvino sehwaro uye wakafungawo nzira yekutarisa.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Kukosha kwakayerwa kamwe chete hakugoni kuvimbwa, saka ritsvaire kure.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wakatsvairawo kukosha kwaungashandisa. Kukosha kwakayerwa kamwe chete kwakakosha seumboo.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Nekunyora 'anenge,' wakasiya poinzi yekuti pamwe haisi chaiyo.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Boka B rakayera hallway imwe chete zvakare ndokuwana 3m 46cm.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Unofunga sei kana ukaona makosha maviri (3m 40cm ne3m 46cm)?
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Kana ukabvisa 3m 40cm kubva ku3m 46cm, pane musiyano we6cm. Zvakajeka kuti makosha akayerwa kamwe chete anosiyana ne6cm. Panzvimbo pekutaura kuti rimwe divi rakashata, zvakanaka kubvunza kuti vakayera sei kana kuyera kamwe zvakare.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Kukosha kweBoka A kwakarurama, uye Boka B rakashata.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Hauna kuziva kuti vakayera sei, asi wakasarudza kuti rimwe rakarurama.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Vanosiyana ne6cm, asi hatigoni kusarudza kuti ndeipi inovimbika zvakanyanya.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wakaona musiyano wemakosha maviri uye wakacherekedza kuti hapana hwaro hwekusarudza.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Hallway yakareba pakati penguva mbiri idzi.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakafunga kuti kureba kwe hallway kwakachinja. Funga kana nzira yekuyera ingaita musiyano.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Makosha maviri ari padhuze, saka unogona kutaura kuti ose ari anenge 3m 40cm. Yera kamwe zvakare.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Kuona kuti makosha maviri anosiyana ne6cm, wakafunga nezvekureba kwakapoteredza uye chiito chinotevera pamwe chete.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Zvakabuda kuti Boka A rakayera richiisa chiratidzo nechoko pamagumo enhonga nguva imwe neimwe, uye Boka B rakafambisa nhonga pasina kuisa chiratidzo. Kana ukaifambisa pasina chiratidzo, nhonga inowanzo kufukidzana kana kusiya mikaha. Boka C rakayera zvakare richiisa chiratidzo ndokuwana 3m 41cm.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Zvaizova zvakanaka kupfupisa sei kureba kwe hallway?
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Makosha maviri akayerwa nechiratidzo (3m 40cm, 3m 41cm) anosiyana ne1cm chete, saka nzira iyoyo inogona kuonekwa seinovimbika zvakanyanya. Zvisinei, panzvimbo pekurasa 3m 46cm zvachose, zvakanaka kunyora kuti 'pamwe yakasiyana nekuti pakanga pasina chiratidzo.' Kuitaura serenji rakapararira pamusoro pemakosha matatu kunakawo.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Refu zvikuru, 3m 46cm, ndiyo yechokwadi, uye dzimwe dzakayerwa pfupi.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakafunga kuti kukosha kukuru kunogara kuri kwakarurama. Kana nhonga ikafukidzana, inogona chaizvo kubuda yakareba.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: 3m 40cm ne3m 41cm dzakayerwa nechiratidzo dziri padhuze, saka itore seanenge 3m 40cm, uye utsvage zvakawanda nezvekuti nei 3m 46cm yakasiyana.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakashandisa sehwaro kuti makosha akayerwa nenzira imwe chete ari padhuze, uye wakatarisawo chikonzero chekukosha kumwe.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Makosha anosiyana nguva imwe neimwe tinoyera, saka kureba kwe hallway hakugoni kuzikanwa.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wakati kureba hakugoni kuzikanwa zvachose nekuti makosha anosiyana zvishoma. Tarisa kana makosha ari padhuze achiungana panzvimbo imwe.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Vimba makosha ose matatu uye utaure kuti hallway iri pakati pe3m 40cm ne3m 46cm.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Hauna kurasa kukosha kupi nekupi uye wakataura renji rinopararirwa nemakosha.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.reflect: Kukosha kwakayerwa kamwe chete kwaigona kushandiswa se 'anenge' chete, uye kana kukosha kwechipiri kwasvika, kwakaratidza kuti pane musiyano we6cm. Kana ruzivo rutsva, nzira yekuyera, rwasvika, pakanga paine hwaro hwekutaura kuti kukosha kupi kunovimbika zvakanyanya. Panzvimbo pekuvimba kukosha kumwe seyakarurama, zvakanaka kutarisa pamwe chete kwakaungana makosha nenzira.

z-m-06-04.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora makosha matatu akayerwa padivi pemumwe uye uparadzanise akafanana zvikuru pamwe chete.
z-m-06-04.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kana mashoko awakanyora achiita kuti muverengi aziwe kuti angavimba kukosha uku zvakadii.
z-m-06-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora kureba kuti muverengi arege kunzwisisa zvisina kururama se 'zvakadai chaizvo' here?
z-m-06-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Chikonzero chako chakabva panzira yekuyera kana kumisiyano yemakosha here?

z-m-06-06.title: Kubva ku cm ingani pensera 'yakareba'?
z-m-06-06.goal: Seta chiyero chekupatsanura chinogona kusiyana kubva kumunhu kuenda kune mumwe, senge 'pensera refu,' zvakajeka nenhamba senge kureba (cm), uye ziva kuti zvinyorwa zvakawanda zvinogoneka kune data imwe chete.

z-m-06-11.title: Rondedzero ipi yesarudzo yakanaka paongororo pamusoro pokuti vadzidzi vanouya sei kuchikoro?
z-m-06-11.topic: Ongororo: kuchinjana nezvikamu zvakashaikwa pakugadzira rondedzero yesarudzo
z-m-06-11.goal: Ziva kuti rondedzero yesarudzo yeongororo haifaniri kuchinjana uye inofanira kubata mamiriro akashaikwa kuti shamwari yega yega ikwanise kusarudza imwe chete, uye utsvage woruramisa dambudziko mune rondedzero yesarudzo.
z-m-06-11.material: Kirasi 3 yeGredhi 2 iri kuita ongororo pamusoro pa 'kuti unouya sei kuchikoro.' Munhu mumwe nomumwe anosarudza nzira imwe chete yaanoshandisa kazhinji. Takafunga marondedzero matatu esarudzo. (가) netsoka, bhazi, subway, dzimwe nzira (나) netsoka, bhazi, subway, bhasikoro, mota (다) netsoka, mudhudhudhu, bhazi, bhasikoro. Hatinawo kuziva kuti shamwari dziri mukirasi ino dzinoshandisa nzira dzipi chaidzo. Panogona kuva neshamwari dzinokwira sikuta kana bhazi remusha.
z-m-06-11.s.s1.prompt: Rondedzero ipi yesarudzo inoita kuti munhu mumwe nomumwe asarudze imwe chete uye achiona bhokisi rimwe chete?
z-m-06-11.s.s1.hint.0: Pamarondedzero ose, tarisa rimwe nerimwe kuti shamwari inouya nekick scooter ine here sero yokusarudza.
z-m-06-11.s.s1.hint.1: Pamarondedzero ose, verenga kuti munhu ane sero imwe here kana sero mbiri kana kupfuura dzaanogona kusarudza.
z-m-06-11.s.s1.r.a: Wakakanganwa kuti bhazi nebhasikoro zvinosanganisirwa mumudhudhudhu, saka munhu mumwe anogona kukodzera masero maviri.
z-m-06-11.s.s1.r.b: Wakatarisa kuti masero haachinjani uye kuti nzira yakasiiwa inogona kusarudzwa pa "dzimwe nzira".
z-m-06-11.s.s1.r.c: Nzira shanu idzi hadzichinjani. Asi funga kuti shamwari inoshandisa kick scooter kana bhazi remusha yaizosarudza papi.
z-m-06-11.s.s1.r.d: Hauna kutarisa kana rondedzero yega yega ine zvinochinjana kana mamiriro akashaikwa.
z-m-06-11.s.s1.explain: (가) haichinjani, uye nokuti nzira yoga yoga inoshandiswa, shamwari inogona kusarudza bhokisi rimwe. (나) inogona kushandiswa chete kana uchinyatsoziva pachine nguva kuti shamwari dziri mukirasi ino dzinoshandisa imwe chete yenzira shanu. (다) ine mudhudhudhu unochinjana nebhazi nebhasikoro, saka munhu mumwe anogona kukodzera mabhokisi maviri.
z-m-06-11.s.s2.prompt: Ipa muenzaniso mumwe weshamwari ine dambudziko rokusarudza pamarondedzero (다) inouya kuchikoro sei, uye nyora kuti rondedzero (다) yaizoruramiswa sei.
z-m-06-11.s.s2.hint.0: Tsvaga unyore mamiriro ari murondedzero (다) umo shamwari imwe chete ine mabhokisi maviri yaigona kusarudza.
z-m-06-11.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kana shamwari iyoyo ichigona kusarudza bhokisi rimwe chete nerondedzero yakaruramiswa.
z-m-06-11.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa here nomuenzaniso wako kuti munhu mumwe anokodzera mabhokisi maviri?
z-m-06-11.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Nzira yako yokururamisa inobvisa here kuchinjana?
z-m-06-11.s.s2.model.0: Shamwari inouya nebhazi inogona kusarudza zvose 'mudhudhudhu' ne 'bhazi,' saka zvinovhiringa. 'Mudhudhudhu' unosanganisira bhazi nebhasikoro zvose, saka imwe yacho inofanira kubviswa.
z-m-06-11.s.s2.model.1: Shamwari inouya nebhasikoro inokodzera zvose mudhudhudhu nebhasikoro, saka zvinochinjana. Bvisa 'mudhudhudhu' woisa 'dzimwe nzira.'

z-m-06-11.s.s3.prompt: Takaita ongororo nerondedzero (가) uye 'dzimwe nzira' dzakabuda dzakawanda kupfuura dzose. Chii chaizova chakanaka kuita tisati tazivisa mhedzisiro yeongororo?
z-m-06-11.s.s3.hint.0: Funga kuti ruzivo rupi runoshaikwa mumhedzisiro yeongororo nokuti vakawanda vakapindura 'dzimwe nzira.'
z-m-06-11.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora kuti ndeshamwari dzipi dzinofanira kuongororwazve uye kuti mhedzisiro yakatotorwa yaigona kushandiswa sei.
z-m-06-11.s.s3.o.a: Zivisa mhedzisiro sezvayakaita, uchiti dzimwe nzira ndidzo dzakawanda kupfuura dzose.
z-m-06-11.s.s3.r.a: Wakazivisa usingazivi kuti dzimwe nzira dzinosanganisira dzipi. Zvakaoma kuti vaverengi vezviziviso vanzwisise.
z-m-06-11.s.s3.o.b: Dzima bhokisi redzimwe nzira uzivise uchienzanisa mabhokisi akasara chete.
z-m-06-11.s.s3.r.b: Wakadzima bhokisi rakawana mhinduro dzakawanda zvikuru. Chikamu chikuru chemhinduro dzeshamwari dzakaongororwa chaizoshaikwa.
z-m-06-11.s.s3.o.c: Bvunza shamwari dzimwe nzira dzadzinoshandisa uzvigoverezve.
z-m-06-11.s.s3.r.c: Iyi ndiyo pfungwa yokugoverezve mukati medzimwe nzira kuti utsvage dzinoshandiswa kazhinji.
z-m-06-11.s.s3.o.d: Dzokorora ongororo yose kubva pakutanga uzivise patsva.
z-m-06-11.s.s3.r.d: Wakarasa mhedzisiro yose yakatotorwa. Funga kana zvichikwana kuzoziva zvakare bhokisi redzimwe nzira chete.
z-m-06-11.s.s3.explain: Kana dzimwe nzira ndidzo dzakawanda, zvaizova zvakanaka kutsvaga kuti nzira dzipi dzinoshandiswa kazhinji mukati madzo. Kana ukabvunza shamwari dziri mubhokisi iroro chete uchizvigoverezve, unogona kushandisa mhedzisiro yakatotorwa usingaitarisi.
z-m-06-11.s.s3.acc.0: Kudzokorora ongororo kubva pakutanga inzirawo, asi zvakakodzera zvikuru kushandisa mhedzisiro yakatowanikwa woziva zvakare chikamu chakashaikwa chete.
